LDS.caveat: Digs and serving only. Serve-receive -- the libero's primary job -- is absent from the feed entirely, so this board is the least supported.
LDS.label: Libero / DS

MB.caveat: Blocks and efficiency are measured, but a middle swings less often, so efficiency moves on low volume. Block assists are shared credit.
MB.label: Middle blocker

OH.caveat: Scoring and efficiency are measured directly. Serve-receive is not in the box score, and passing is half an outside's job.
OH.label: Outside hitter

OPP.caveat: The opposite's job is scoring, which the box score sees well. Smallest sample of the five positions.
OPP.label: Opposite

S.caveat: Assists count the offence her team runs, not how well she sets. A 6-2 splits them between two setters, which understates both.
S.label: Setter

meta.all_star_note: constructed from the position boards, not voted on; each slot is filled from its own position's board and no libero is ever compared with a middle
meta.blend_note: measured, not chosen: share of the rating carried by this season at n matches played
meta.cannot_see: serve-receive is absent from the feed, so passing -- a libero's and an outside's primary job -- is not measured anywhere in this rating
meta.criterion: weights fitted to predict AVCA All-America selection with team strength held constant; validated among players on comparable teams

opponent_adjustment.note: every component is normalised to a neutral schedule using within-player slopes; a player whose opponents are unrated is left unadjusted and flagged

meta.passing_note: passing, touches and rotation role come from the 2025 play-by-play; there is no live source for them this season

role_split.note: reception share where the distribution itself separates a six-rotation pin from a front-row one -- the valley in the histogram, not a chosen threshold
role_split.pass_role_note: how much serve-receive she is trusted with -- NOT whether she plays the back row
role_split.rotation_note: six-rotation is proven by serving: reaching the service line requires standing in position 1. Of the players who never serve, zero have a back-row attack.

meta.scale_from: 2025 full season -- a finished distribution, so an early-season rate is not scored against whoever happens to have played

overall.note: a comparison of standing, not of value: it says how far above her own position's field she is, and never that one position outranks another
